A game of Go for the Mudita Kompakt. 9x9, against the computer or two people sharing the
phone, with [GNU Go](https://www.gnu.org/software/gnugo/) as the engine.

No permissions, no network, nothing leaves the device — see [PRIVACY.md](PRIVACY.md).

**Installing:** arm64-v8a only, which is what the Kompakt is. Verify the download against
the `.sha256` beside it if you like.

Free software under the GPLv3. The engine's complete source is in `engine/` in this repo,
unmodified, along with the script that builds it.
